# Tom the Chiropractor

> Chiropractic clinic in central Loughborough, Leicestershire, UK, run by one chiropractor, Tom Wikeley (MChiro, GCC-registered, fully insured). Treats back, neck, shoulder, joint and muscle pain, headaches that come from the neck, sciatica, and neck and back pain from desk work. The same chiropractor at every appointment, with appointments until 7pm on Mondays and Thursdays and on Saturday mornings. Initial consultation £70 (60 minutes), follow-up treatment £45.

## Key facts

- Practitioner: Tom Wikeley, MChiro, Welsh Institute of Chiropractic, registered with the General Chiropractic Council (GCC No. 05268), fully insured. Registration can be checked at https://www.gcc-uk.org/find-a-chiropractor
- Location: The Work Lounge, 1 Beehive Lane, Loughborough, Leicestershire, LE11 2FJ. Beehive Lane Car Park is opposite
- Hours: Monday 9am-7pm, Thursday 9am-7pm, Saturday 9am-2pm. Appointments are booked in advance; no walk-ins
- Booking: online booking widget at https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/#book, or WhatsApp +44 7871 283457. No GP referral needed
- Pricing: initial consultation £70 (60 minutes), follow-up treatment £45, block of 5 follow-ups £200 (£40/visit)
- Student and under-16 rates: student follow-up £40, student block of 5 £180, follow-ups for under-16s £35
- Areas served: Loughborough and nearby villages including Shepshed, Quorn, Barrow upon Soar, Sileby, Mountsorrel, Hathern, East Leake and Kegworth (10 to 20 minutes by car)
- Google rating: 5.0 from 15 reviews

- [Shoulder pain](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/conditions/shoulder-pain.html): causes of shoulder pain and how chiropractic treatment helps

- [Sciatica](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/conditions/sciatica.html): causes of leg pain from the lower back and how chiropractic treatment helps
- [Free desk check](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/desk-check.html): free two-minute self-assessment of desk and workstation setup, scored out of 10, based on the Rapid Office Strain Assessment, with an optional emailed results summary
- [How much does a chiropractor cost in Loughborough?](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/questions/chiropractor-cost-loughborough.html): pricing for first appointments, follow-ups, block bookings, student and under-16 rates
- [Chiropractor or physiotherapist?](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/questions/chiropractor-vs-physiotherapist.html): how the two professions differ and how Tom decides what's appropriate
- [Chiropractor or osteopath?](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/questions/chiropractor-vs-osteopath.html): how the two professions differ, how both are regulated, and how to choose
- [Is chiropractic treatment safe?](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/questions/is-chiropractic-safe.html): GCC regulation, common side effects, and who should see a GP first
- [What happens at your first appointment](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/questions/first-appointment.html): a step-by-step walkthrough of a first visit
- [How many appointments will I need?](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/questions/how-many-appointments.html): what affects recovery time, without promising a fixed number
- [Block booking terms](https://www.tomthechiropractor.co.uk/block-booking-terms.html): terms for the block of 5 treatments
